description.short: Manage ServiceNow incidents and user profiles with authorized directory context
description.full: Investigate workplace IT symptoms and read recent incidents and change requests with original source links. Perform authorized incident operations, generic source user profile CRUD and separately policy-controlled group/role eligibility through one shared authenticated ServiceNow MCP. For ordinary name-only assignment requests, dynamically resolve the person with the current host's authorized Work IQ or directory capability and handle technical login/email internally. Preflight the reviewed eligibility policy before creating an absent source user, then assess and apply only authorized missing access before guarded assignment. No preconfigured person lists, manual source setup or direct API workaround. Preserve source restrictions, distinct profile/access scopes, native confirmation, source schema/version and deletion-impact guards. Creation alone is not assignment readiness. Change requests remain read-only; passwords and role grants are not ordinary profile fields.

agentConnectors.description: Shared authenticated incident operations, generic user profile CRUD and reviewed access continuation, filtered by Incident.Manage, User.Manage and User.Access.Manage. Directory context belongs to the agent; profile fields cannot grant passwords or roles.
